name: huntdown
features: native 320x240 4:3 logical view at 640x480 without the force169 override
4:3 intro and story videos use proportional vertical fit with centered side crop
recognized analytics login and server-send coroutines disabled opportunistically
recognized distributor-injected player preferences and extractor removed opportunistically
known_limitations: The 4:3 result is structurally verified but has not yet been visually verified on the target device.
The target Android surface must actually be 4:3 for the computed 320x240 view and zero offsets.

compatibility.strategy: required arm64 4:3 instruction signatures and ELF mapping; source-specific cleanup is optional
notes: classes3.dex and assets/data0 are never required: recognized injected copies are neutralized, absent copies are ignored, and unknown copies are preserved.
The shared optional branding cleanup remains responsible for recognized APKVision runtime wrappers.
Billing, purchases, cloud saves, platform authentication, achievements, and Play Games are preserved.
